name: Kobee Studio
description: Create PCB labels, symbols, component callouts, header overlays, QR Codes, and barcodes inside KiCad
description_full: Kobee Studio creates editable PCB artwork on silkscreen, copper, and solder-mask layers. It includes parametric labels with optional underlines, PCB symbols, searchable presets, custom SVG uploads, icon and quick-label visibility controls, saved profiles, mm and mil display units, component callouts and arrays, configurable 2.54 mm header overlays, QR Codes, Code 128 barcodes, and optional readable text beneath machine codes. Kobee Studio evolved from KiBuzzard and now provides a modern KiCad 10 IPC workflow for creating consistent PCB graphics.
